scope_selected: Selected Tasks (subagents are not included automatically)
scope_suffix: . Native Task names and agent aliases are preferred; missing names are never filled from prompts.
coverage_summary: {selected_files} local record pages; observed scope only, not a complete account-wide bill.
coverage_tree_limited: Agent tree reached its count/depth limit; descendant usage is incomplete
coverage_evidence_limited: Some evidence is missing or conflicting
coverage_native_history_limit: Native history is limited to the newest 1,000 snapshots
windows_note: Windows use [start, end); overlapping windows must not be added. No observation does not mean zero usage.
credits_note: Credits are rate-scenario estimates for the same tokens, not actual charges or subscription percentages.
no_native_snapshot: No saved native snapshot; quota and subscription were not observed, which does not mean zero.
native_saved: Saved at {time}; {seconds} seconds before report end (not a live read).
native_credits: {limit} credits balance {balance}; separate from subscription-included quota.
delta_no_compare: {count} native snapshots in this window; not enough before/after evidence for a comparison.
delta_scope: Account snapshot subinterval {since} → {until}; not the full report window and cannot be allocated to Tasks.
parent_conflict: Conflicting parent evidence; ownership not assigned
model_caption: Showing {shown} of {total} groups, sorted by tokens.
turns_caption: Showing newest {shown} of {total} groups; unidentified turns are combined as unknown, not a count of completed turns.
evidence_intro: Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning tokens. Do not add subsets again. Missing settings are not replaced by current settings.
evidence_scenario: Scenario estimates may exclude unknown models or unsupported token bases; exclusion does not mean free.
no_mutation: This report does not change budgets, hooks, Task state, settings or quota; use --format json for complete structured evidence.
html_windows_note: Measured by request time · overlapping windows must not be added · unobserved ≠ zero usage
task_picker: Detail Task (does not change the summary above)
noscript: JavaScript is disabled: all windows are shown in order and filters are unavailable.
html_model_note: Unknown Fast does not mean off; plan is a nearby observation, not the charge plan for every request.
html_turns_caption: Newest {shown} of {total} groups. Unknown turns are combined; this is not a completed-turn count.
scenario_coverage: Scenario estimate covers {priced} requests and excludes {excluded}; exclusion does not mean free.
html_evidence_intro: Input already includes cached tokens and output already includes reasoning; do not double-count. Historical settings are not filled from current settings. Token shares cannot allocate account quota; Standard/Fast scenarios are not proof of actual charges.
html_sensitive_note: Task names and agent aliases come from native metadata and may be sensitive; check before sharing. IDs are hashed. Prompts, previews and conversation content are never used as names.
status_template: {window} · {task} · {rows} filtered detail rows (including collapsed content; not request count)
status_empty: · No detail rows are available in this scope; also check truncation and coverage.
menu:
Codex usage analysis: choose a scope first; full history is never read automatically.
- report tasks: recent Task names and selectors; metadata only.
- report task: current Task, recent 24h; use --thread with a selector.
- report agents: current Task's agent relationships; no Token records.
- report tree: explicit current Task and subagents, recent 24h.
- report window --windows 5h: one window for the current Task.
Cross-Task analysis requires explicit --all-tasks; default maximum is 20 pages and 20 detail groups.
Reports are saved with a short summary; --full prints the complete report to stdout.
Codex slash entry: /skills → usage-task / usage-agents / usage-window.
summary_files: Analyzed {files} local record pages; full report saved.
summary_tree_limited: Agent tree reached its count/depth limit; descendant usage is incomplete.
